In the United States, you must be at least **21 years old** to purchase tobacco products [d1][d6]. This was established by the federal "Tobacco 21" law signed on December 20, 2019, which raised the minimum age from 18 to 21 and applies to all tobacco products, including e-cigarettes, with no exceptions for any retailer or purchaser [d1][d8][d10]. The law applies in all 50 states, the District of Columbia, U.S. territories, and Tribal jurisdictions, with no exemptions for military personnel or any other group [d3][d8][d10]. Additionally, as of September 30, 2024, retailers are required to check a photo ID for anyone under the age of 30 attempting to purchase tobacco products [d1][d6].
